title: Revisiting MAE pre-training for 3D medical image segmentation
mechanism: Masked-autoencoder pretraining of an nnU-Net residual-encoder CNN on a large unlabelled pool with a configuration study, then nnU-Net fine-tuning.
adaptation: MAE-pretrain a 2D ResEnc-L on the 159k-cell unlabelled pool (13x the 11.9k used before), fine-tune with PF so the encoder is kept, label-safe aug, our folds.
min_experiment: MAE ResEnc-L (PF) v scratch ResEnc-L, 2 seeds x 5 folds. Kill if CV crack IoU < +0.01 and E1 relF1@2 < +0.03.
evidence: R: abstract reports SSL on a large clinical pool improving nnU-Net downstream segmentation (details not read).
prior_overlap: MIM on ResNet-34 with the 11.9k pool, then house and PF fine-tune: n.d. This differs in pool size, architecture and MAE recipe, so not closed.
